questions.question_text: Which statement correctly characterizes the core principle of Five Earth Spheres in Chapter 13 (Earth as a System: Energy, Matter, and Life)?

questions.question_text: What is the standard SI unit or characteristic associated with Solar Radiation Balance?

Option B: Standard unit defined by international system
Option C: Meters per second (m/s)
Option D: Dimensionless ratio

questions.question_text:
